name: 143-voice.1 — the engine in-tree, and hafen.voice() opens the link
author: brodgar
description: Self-checking suite for task 143.1: hafen.voice() as the collection of live voice links, :connection(url) built bare with its connect-time setters, session() in its three arities, the closed key set, :connect() as the gate and the dispatch under voice.connect and the network block with the one-link-per-server refusal, :close(), the retired push-to-talk binding, and Open, Close and Error heard on the step against the real server and a host that does not resolve.
